scenario: A librarian is explaining how to use the main campus library.

sentences.text: Please bring your student card inside.
The service desk is near the front door.
Students may borrow up to ten books for three weeks.
Group study rooms should be reserved online at least a day ahead.
Drinks with lids are allowed, but hot food is not permitted near the computers.
If the book you need is already checked out, place a hold using your card.
chunks: you need is already checked out,

sentences.text: Please return every item to the outdoor bin after closing so that you avoid a late fee.
chunks: to the outdoor bin after closing

scenario: A nurse is giving instructions at the campus health clinic.

sentences.text: Check in at the front window.
Have your student card and appointment number ready.
Please sit in the blue chairs until your name is called.
Tell the nurse about any regular medicine you already take each day.
If you feel dizzy after the visit, do not walk home alone tonight.
The pharmacy next door can fill a simple prescription before six o'clock on weekdays.
Call the clinic the same day if a fever starts or if the pain becomes much worse.
chunks: the same day if a fever starts

scenario: A tutor is explaining the rules of the writing center.

sentences.text: Sign up before you come in.
Bring a printed draft of your paper with you.
A tutor will ask what part you want to improve first.
We will not rewrite the whole essay for you during the session.
You should leave with a short list of changes to make before tomorrow.
Appointments last twenty-five minutes, so please arrive a little early and ready to talk.
chunks: so please arrive a little early

sentences.text: If you miss two appointments without notice, you must wait a week before booking another one.

scenario: A staff member is describing move-in day at a student residence.

sentences.text: Collect your key from the lobby desk.
Elevators are reserved for people carrying boxes this morning.
Please label every box with your name and room number.
Cars may stop at the side door for only fifteen minutes.
Quiet hours begin at ten tonight, including the hallways and the kitchen.
Report a broken lock or a missing chair on the housing form before you unpack.
Roommates should agree on a cleaning plan this weekend so shared spaces stay fair for everyone.
chunks: on a cleaning plan this weekend

scenario: A driver is announcing rules on the campus shuttle.

sentences.text: Have your pass ready to scan.
The next stop is the science building entrance.
Please move back so more riders can board at this stop.
Please hold the metal rail while the bus turns onto College Avenue.
Bags belong on your lap or under the seat, not in the aisle.
This evening shuttle does not run after midnight on Friday or on Saturday night.
If you miss the last bus, the night ride line can send a car to the library.

scenario: A coordinator is briefing students at a career fair.

sentences.text: Pick up a name tag first.
Employers are seated by field along the side walls.
You may visit any table, but wait until the person is free.
Please offer a short personal introduction and one clean copy of your resume.
Ask about internships that start in June rather than asking only about full-time jobs.
Write the name of each person you meet so you can send a thank-you note.
The fair closes at three, and leftover guides will be outside the career office tomorrow morning.

scenario: A clerk is helping a student at the registrar window.

sentences.text: Take a number and wait to be called.
Course changes are accepted through Friday of this week.
Bring a photo identification card before we can print your schedule.
A full-time load is at least twelve credits in the fall term.
If a class is closed, ask about the waiting list before you leave.
Official transcripts ordered today are sent electronically within three business days of the request.
Please check your student account tonight to confirm that the new section replaced the old one.

scenario: A lab supervisor is giving a safety briefing before a chemistry session.

sentences.text: Wear goggles before you touch anything.
Tie back long hair and roll loose sleeves.
Please read the full safety label twice before you pour.
Point every test tube away from other people when you heat it.
Spill kits are under the sink, and you should call a supervisor at once.
Never taste a sample or return any unused liquid back to the original bottle on the shelf.
Please wash your hands and wipe the bench before you leave, even if the experiment seemed completely safe.
chunks: and wipe the bench before you
